name: Phtonix: Auto-Zoom Recorder & Screenshots
description: Record your screen with cinematic auto-zoom, or frame screenshots on a gradient you mix yourself. Fully local, no account.

content_security_policy.extension_pages: script-src 'self'; object-src 'self'; connect-src 'none'; img-src 'self' data: blob:; media-src 'self' blob:; style-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline'; font-src 'self'
